answer: Prayers & Duties >> Jumuah & Eid Prayers Question ID: 10613 Country: India Title: Assalamu Alaikum Jummma ki namaz me sunnat namaz aur nafil namaz patneki niyath kya he? jumma ki sunnat, ya zohar ki sunnat, kya niyath karna chahiye? Question: Assalamu Alaikum Jummma ki namaz me sunnat namaz aur nafil namaz patneki niyath kya he? jumma ki sunnat, ya zohar ki sunnat, kya niyath karna chahiye? Answer ID: 10613 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 134/131=L/1429) It is sufficient to intend nafl or sunnah in the heart whether it is of Zuhr or Jumuah i.e. one thinks in heart that he is going to perform so and so nafl or sunnah . Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
